messages.text: I'm writing a design doc about how the app reads long documents. Where is the size of a single read set, and how big is it?
What does the repository importer always leave out of a codebase, whatever its .gitignore says? Cite the file and line.
When a repository is refreshed, how does a chat that already read one of its files find out the file changed?
Write a short design note at Design/Reading code: how the model lists, reads and searches a repository's files today (line numbers, line ranges, search hits), citing path:line for each claim.
